import unreal
rt=unreal.load_asset('/Game/SSPR_Validation/RT_SSPR_Occupancy')
rows=[]
for c in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraComponent):
    asset=c.get_asset()
    if asset and asset.get_path_name()=='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest' and c.get_owner() is None:
        c.set_variable_texture_render_target('User.OccupancyRTParam',rt)
        c.set_force_solo(True)
        c.set_age_update_mode(unreal.NiagaraAgeUpdateMode.TICK_DELTA_TIME)
        c.reinitialize_system()
        c.activate(True)
        c.set_component_tick_enabled(True)
        c.advance_simulation(30,1.0/60.0)
        rows.append({'component':c.get_path_name(),'active':bool(c.is_active()),'tick':bool(c.is_component_tick_enabled()),'solo':bool(c.get_force_solo())})
print('PREVIEW_WRITERS='+repr(rows))
del c
del rows
del rt
